text: It is a mistake to think that a thought or will can have effect only when it is expressed in speech or act: the unspoken thought, the unexpressed will are also active energies and can produce their own vibrations, effects or reactions.
author: Sri Aurobindo

text: To be calm, undisturbed, quiet, to have a settled trust and confidence in the working of the Divine Power is the proper foundation of a sound sadhana.
author: Sri Aurobindo

text: Always behave as if the Mother was looking at you, because she is, indeed, always present.
author: The Mother

text: The mind must learn to be silent, then only can the higher Light descend and the true knowledge come.
author: Sri Aurobindo

text: By your aspiration, your sincerity, your self-giving, you can become what you aspire to be.
author: The Mother

text: A quiet mind, a calm vital, a peaceful heart — these are the foundation on which the inner life can be built.
author: Sri Aurobindo
